lines.en: I cross the paddock, mud underfoot.
Frill forward, I walk unhurried.
My nose horn pushes brush aside.

lines.zh: 四条腿一起压下去，地会响。
lines.en: Four legs press down; the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我沿着电网边走，避开它。
lines.en: I walk the fence line, clear of it.
I push through the ferns.
My tail swings. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我绕着饲料槽走了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the feeding trough.
Mud cakes thick on my feet.
I head for the water, step by step.
My frill is bright in the sun.
I do not run. My weight is enough.
Mud drips from the edge of my frill.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到圈的另一边。
lines.en: I shift to the paddock's far side.
Head down, I chew slowly.
My tail sweeps lightly over the water.
Tree shadows fall across my frill.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的电子嗡鸣。
lines.en: I hear the distant electric hum.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢电网，但习惯了。
lines.en: I dislike the fence. I am used to it.
I shake my head at the flies.
I grind my teeth slowly.
Sun warms my back.
I lie down and tuck my legs.
My nose horn points at the earth.

lines.zh: 围栏另一边，有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves beyond the fence.
My breathing is coarse.
I wait for the keeper.

lines.zh: 这片泥地，我熟得能闭眼。
lines.en: I know this mud well.
You stand outside the fence, watching.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾不是给我看的。
lines.en: The frill is not for me to look at.
This nose horn of mine grows slowly.
Do not tap the fence. I hear it.
Coming in? The gate is over there.

lines.zh: 鼻角下方，鼻孔一张一合。
lines.en: Under my nose horn, my nostrils flare.
You are much shorter than the keeper.
I lift my head and my frill spreads.
This grass is mine.
I plant myself, frill spread toward you.
My horn points down, not at you.
Are you recording me?
A blow lands on my frill.

lines.zh: 我的鼻角一顶，灌木就开了。
lines.en: One push of my nose horn opens the brush.
I growl low.
A pale mark is left on my frill.
My nose horn sits askew.

lines.zh: 皮很厚，但也破了，颈盾还挡着。
lines.en: My hide is thick and torn; the frill still guards.
Shake the head, fling the pain away.
Drops of blood on the mud.
I do not run. I turn to you.
That should keep you back.
One bite takes half the fern clump.
That grass is too dry.
Put it in the trough.
I eat ferns; you keep the fruit.
That is not one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我这颈盾上，插着六根长角。
lines.en: Six long horns stud my frill.
I want water more.
Keep your hand out of the rails.
I smell fresh cut grass.
That will keep me chewing.
Hit me and you hit a wall.
My frill is harder than you think.
My frill grazes your shoulder.
I turn and mud sprays.
Do not stand at my flank.
I lean in, and your feet slip.

lines.zh: 颈盾上的长角，别靠太近。
lines.en: Mind the horns on my frill.
That done, I step back slowly.
Your prints sink deep in mud.
After the bump, I have not moved.
I am alone in this paddock.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾是给同类看的。
lines.en: My frill is for my own kind.
The keepers arrange such things.
I turn my frill sideways for you to see.
My weight does not suit it.

lines.zh: 野外的同类，早就不见了。
lines.en: My wild kin are long gone.
Say nothing. Fences have ears.

lines.zh: 我鼻上的角，比你手臂长。
lines.en: The horn on my nose is longer than your arm.

lines.zh: 换个话题，问你自己的事。
lines.en: Ask about yourself instead.
I lower my head. No answer.
I take the bundle of grass.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我用角顶回去。
lines.en: I push your fallen thing back with my horn.
I curl a fern into my mouth.
I do not collect. I eat.
Roots in the mud are food too.

lines.zh: 东西掉进泥里，找不到了。
lines.en: In the mud, it is lost.

lines.zh: 我这排颈盾上的角，可不是石头。
lines.en: The spikes on my frill are not stone.

lines.zh: 你把草放低些，我够不到。
lines.en: Lower it. I cannot reach.
Too hard. I cannot chew it.
I snatch it up and toss it onto my back.

lines.zh: 鼻角对准了，颈盾挡住头。
lines.en: Nose horn forward, frill covering my head.
Something in the paddock came close.
I paw the ground twice.
Frill spread. This is a warning.

lines.zh: 颈盾一圈尖刺，正对着你。
lines.en: A ring of spikes on my frill, aimed at you.
You crossed that line.
I start forward. Steady.
I will not ease this charge.
You backed to the electric fence.
My forehoof paws a muddy pit.

lines.zh: 我鼻上的角，对准你的胸口。
lines.en: The horn on my snout aims at your chest.
Prove yourself, then. Come.
My horn lowers once.
Frill forward, my whole head bears down.
My nose horn lowers toward your knee.
Mud lifts under my feet.
Retreat and the fence is behind you.

lines.zh: 我的颈盾挡住了你的视线。
lines.en: My frill blocks your view.
No hurry. My weight is here.
You stepped in my pawed hollow.
I turn slowly and truly.
Counting my steps?
The horn tip points at your chest.
You feel the ground shiver.
One step more and you are at the fence.
I tilt my head to judge where you stand.
Four thick legs pack the mud down.
Three steps out, my horn already aimed.
I plant four legs and wait for you to charge.
My nose horn hits your chest.
My frill swings; you give ground.

lines.zh: 这一下，被我的重量带着。
lines.en: My weight carries that blow.
My foreleg stamps; mud flies.
You are knocked back two blocks.
Head low, I ram my horn at your shield.
The frill arrives first.
My horn is turned, but my shoulder slams in.
My feet stamp a crater.

lines.zh: 我的角划开了你的护甲。
lines.en: My horn splits your armor.

lines.zh: 后退两步，准备再撞一次。
lines.en: I back two steps, ready to ram again.
I step back and heave a breath.
My horn tip hooks your leggings open.
That was half strength.
The paddock gate swings open.

lines.zh: 泥地里多了两行深脚印。
lines.en: Two deep tracks appear in the mud.
I walk out from behind the fence.
My frill opens in the morning light.
A wide swath of grass, flattened by me.

lines.zh: 你听见沉重的脚步了吗？
lines.en: Hear those heavy steps?
A ceratopsian enters the pen.

lines.zh: 泥点子从鼻角上掉下来。
lines.en: Mud drops from my nose horn.
The fence hums. I have arrived.
This grass is mine to eat.
I move off from the trough.
I pull one leg out of the mud pool.
Someone outside the fence. I see.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住了半个圈。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the pen.
I swing my tail and settle.
The area quiets.

lines.zh: 颈盾在灌木上刮出声响。
lines.en: My frill scrapes through the shrubs.
Now, who is outside the fence?
Fire sears my back; my tail swings.
I fall in a pit and cannot rise.

lines.zh: 水浸到肚子，我走不动了。
lines.en: Water to my belly and I stall.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得侧了过去。
lines.en: The blast tips me sideways.

lines.zh: 一根麻醉箭扎在我颈盾上。
lines.en: A dart sticks in my frill.
Magic weighs down my legs.
No grass and I thin.

lines.zh: 电网的火花跳到我身上。
lines.en: Sparks from the fence reach me.
The mud gives way. Emptiness below.
